name: Hong Kong
contextBlurb: Hong Kong has a dedicated stablecoin licensing framework under the Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 656), in force since 1 August 2025. The HKMA finalised supervision and AML/CFT guidance on 29 July 2025 and requires licensed issuers to meet reserve, stabilisation and redemption standards. On 10 April 2026, the HKMA granted the first two stablecoin issuer licences, and the official register showed Anchorpoint Financial Limited and HSBC as licensees effective that date.
